message:
test(ka-pc r2): the kept PCs through the product shell's page, with the real viewer and four hosts

- ka_pc_shell_e2e_test: client_shell_main.cpp with its entry renamed (REMOTE60_SHELL_TEST_SEAM), its WebView page
  clicked through the DOM, GNLinkViewerKaTest children, a real directory and four GNLinkStream hosts -- each its own
  record (registered by the test, handed to the host through its ordinary --directory-cache). The shell's window
  and the viewers' are beyond the screen's right edge. N1 close orders, N2 count/evict-after-success/refusal/failed
  fourth, N3 연결 해제, N4 sign-out fence with a viewer this shell did not start, N6 failed activation, D1 card text
- make_managed_viewers(): the shell's manager built in one place (wWinMain and the e2e)
- units: twenty launch/release cycles hold at most a reaper or two (Codex N5)
- managed e2e: an Activate with the Release right behind it -- no window, no session (Codex N4, init in reverse)
